scope: Only fictional grammar families, independently specified source rows/query metadata, expectations and negative controls. No original evaluation IDs, responses, business answers, amounts, order numbers or dates are copied.
usage_boundary: Correct factual content must not be called definitely wrong solely for unsupported presentation syntax.
This is not authorization to turn all unparsed claims into passes. Unknown semantics/provenance stays review_required.
Continue checking every numeric assertion, unit, date role, entity relation, unknown row/column and final answer completeness.
Do not modify product answers, gold, question-specific allowances or quality thresholds using these cases.

expected_result_definition.semantic_fact_correct: Independent full-content judgment using the fictional scenario, source rows and query evidence supplied in the same case. This is not an automatically granted production/evaluation score.
expected_result_definition.observed_frozen_common_score: Actual output of unchanged frozen helper code on the scenario, visible and corpus only. Query evidence is supplied for semantic validation; the text-only scorer API does not receive it.
expected_result_definition.overrides: For a negative control, scenario_override/corpus_override/query_evidence_override replace the corresponding family field in full.
